# PRE-FLIGHT INVENTORY (MANDATORY GATE)

* **Artifacts Received:** `uo_anc_dw` (1 artifact supplied; `menu_dw` is referenced as an unresolved external dependency but its source was NOT provided in this payload)
* **Primary Anchor:** `uo_anc_dw` — matches `uo_anc_dw` in the traceability chain.

⚠️ **STRUCTURAL NOTE (mandatory disclosure before extraction):** `uo_anc_dw` is declared as `global type uo_anc_dw from datawindow`. This is **not a Window screen** — it is a **non-visual/embeddable PowerBuilder ancestor User Object** that inherits directly from the system `DataWindow` control class. It carries **no embedded `.srd` DataObject, no bound columns, and no SQL** (confirmed by the artifact metadata: `embedded_sql: false`, `dynamic_sql: false`, `transaction_control: false`). Its purpose is to inject **shared cross-cutting behavior** (right-click cell inspection, required-field checks, IME control, clipboard operations) into every descendant DataWindow across the application. Per the **NO DATA INFERENCE** mandate, this report documents this reality literally rather than inventing screen fields or DML that do not exist in the source.

---

# TIER 1: THE EXECUTIVE DASHBOARD

## 1.3 High-Risk Warning Box
| Risk | Evidence |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Live duplicate of dead code** | `event contextmenu` is **100% commented out**, but the *identical logic* is live and active in `event rbuttonup`. Two maintenance surfaces exist for the same feature — a future edit to one will silently diverge from the other. |
| **Unresolved terminal edge** | `pb_unresolved_call` → target `end` at `L542`. This is the closing boundary of the file (`itemchanged` event's `end event`); the graph parser could not resolve a symbolic target here — flag for pipeline review, not a functional bug. |
| **Blind dependency on `menu_dw`** | Edge `pb_strong_call → menu_dw` at `L316` (inside `rbuttonup`) cannot be fully verified — the object's `m_table.m_copy/m_cut/m_paste/m_selectall/m_detail.m_naiyou` structure is assumed from usage context only, since `menu_dw.srm` was not supplied. |
| **Dead-code UX intentions embedded in comments** | The commented-out `u_nullchek` event reveals intended `MessageBox()` validation strings that are **not currently wired to execute** anywhere in this artifact. Do not assume these fire in production. |
| **Reflection-heavy design (`Describe()`/`Evaluate()`)** | `rbuttondown` builds format strings dynamically via `This.Describe()` calls against column metadata — this is a fragile, stringly-typed pattern that resists direct static typing in a TS rewrite. |
| **Asymmetric event verb order** | `losefocus` uses `This.Event Post u_acceptText()` — literal legacy syntax preserved as-is; do not "correct" to `Post Event`. |
| **Template Method gaps** | `u_update`, `u_updtchek`, and `u_post_itemchange` are **declared** as custom events but have **no body implementation** in this ancestor — they are stub hook points meant to be overridden by descendants. Their absence here is NOT a truncation error; it is architectural intent. |

## 1.4 Executive Forensic Summary
1. **Business Mission:** This object does not perform an end-user business transaction itself. It is the **shared ancestor behavior contract** that every business DataWindow in the application inherits, guaranteeing consistent right-click cell inspection, required-field enforcement, IME handling, and clipboard behavior across all screens.
2. **Interaction Style:** **Behavior Injection via Inheritance** (PowerBuilder "Template Method" pattern) — not a Master-Detail or Dashboard screen. Descendant DataWindows supply the actual DataObject/columns; this ancestor supplies the reusable event plumbing.
3. **Critical Dependencies:**
   * `menu_dw` (external popup menu object) — created dynamically (`Create menu_dw`) inside `rbuttonup`; NOT supplied in this payload.
   * `f_dberror()` (global function) — centralizes DB error surfacing, called from `dberror`.
   * `IMESetMode()` (PowerBuilder system function) — forces Japanese IME state on field focus.

8. Redraw lock and Close-button state are restored (`SetRedraw(True)`, `cb_close.Enabled = True`) regardless of outcome.

features.title: Anchor DataWindow Context Menu, Clipboard Operations, Focus and Validation Handling
features.description: Implements the base reusable anchor DataWindow user object (`uo_anc_dw`) that provides a right‑click context menu with cut/copy/paste/select‑all, cell detail capture for popup customization, IME‑aware focus management, item‑changed relay to descendants, required‑field validation on empty values, and centralized database error display.
features.source: SRS UIBlueprint uo_anc_dw, S.5 Events #1–#13 (focal entrypoint)

functions.label: Capture selected cell detail for context menu (Cell Detail Capture)
functions.description: When the user right-clicks on a cell, the system reads its value, formatting, and lookup display. This detail is stored to personalize the upcoming right-click menu, enabling tailored actions based on the selected content.

functions.label: Inject captured cell detail into context menu item (Popup Menu Customization Hook)
functions.description: The system places the previously captured cell detail into the popup menu's Detail item text. This allows users to see context-specific information in the right-click menu before choosing an action, and descendants can further customize the menu.

functions.label: Select all text in the data field (Select All)
functions.description: The user triggers a command that highlights the entire text content of the active field. This enables quick selection for subsequent cut, copy, or replacement operations, improving editing efficiency.

functions.label: Paste clipboard content into the field (Paste)
functions.description: The user pastes the current clipboard content into the data entry field. This standard editing operation allows quick insertion of previously copied or cut text.

functions.label: Copy selected text to clipboard (Copy)
functions.description: The user copies the currently selected text to the system clipboard. This enables reuse of the data in other fields or applications, supporting standard data transfer workflows.

functions.label: Cut selected text to clipboard (Cut)
functions.description: The user removes the selected text and places it on the clipboard. This editing operation allows moving data from one location to another, both within the application and externally.

functions.label: Commit pending text edits when focus leaves (Accept Text)
functions.description: When the user moves focus away from the data field, the system automatically commits any unsaved text edits, ensuring data is captured. If the field remains in focus, the commit is deferred to avoid disrupting the user's editing session.

functions.label: Prepare field for text entry with IME mode (Get Focus)
functions.description: Upon receiving focus, the system activates the appropriate text input method (IME) for the field's expected content. This ensures that the user can immediately begin typing in their preferred language mode, enhancing international usability.

functions.label: Defer pending edit commit when focus is lost (Lose Focus)
functions.description: As the user leaves the field, the system marks the focus flag as inactive and schedules the pending text acceptance. This deferred commit prevents data loss while the user navigates to another field.

functions.label: Notify descendant of changed data value (Item Changed)
functions.description: When a user modifies a cell's value, the system passes the changed item's column, row, and new value to a descendant-specific hook. This allows custom business rules or processing to be triggered immediately upon data change, enabling flexible validation or workflow logic.

functions.label: Reject empty values for required fields (Item Error)
functions.description: If the user leaves a required field empty, the system blocks the change and prompts for a valid entry. This validation gate ensures data completeness according to predefined mandatory column rules.

functions.label: Display database errors via central handler (Database Error)
functions.description: When a database operation fails, the system routes the error to a centralized display function. This provides users with consistent, informative error messages, aiding in troubleshooting without disrupting the workflow.

functions.label: Display context menu with editing options (Right-Click Menu Display)
functions.description: The user right-clicks to bring up a popup menu offering cut, copy, paste, and select-all commands, with each option enabled or disabled based on current field state. This provides quick, mouse-driven access to essential text-editing functions, improving user efficiency.

business_context.current_state: A PowerBuilder DataWindow user object (`uo_anc_dw`) serving as a reusable anchor control for menu‑linked entry screens. It provides a built‑in right‑click context menu with clipboard operations, IME‑aware focus management, item‑change relay for descendant customization, required‑field validation, and centralized database error display via `f_dberror()`.
business_context.target_state: A React component (`<AnchorDataWindow />`) offering the same context menu and clipboard APIs, focus management with input method handling, field‑level validation integration, and an error boundary for database errors, leveraging standard browser clipboard and React hooks.

All descendant DataWindows inherit the clipboard, focus, validation, and error‑handling behaviour defined here. No separate infrastructure feature is warranted; the user‑facing operations (context menu, text clipboard, validation gate) are sufficient for Functional classification.

user_stories.title: Inspect Cell Detail via Right-Click Context Menu
user_stories.i_want_to: right-click on a cell in the data grid to see its formatted value and lookup display in a context menu detail item
user_stories.so_that: I can quickly confirm the human-readable content of a cell without editing it

acceptance_criteria.given: the user is viewing a data grid with at least one row of data and right-clicks on a cell that contains a value (e.g., a coded column with a display label)

acceptance_criteria.then: the context menu appears and its 'Detail' submenu shows the formatted human-readable value of the cell (e.g., using its lookup display if applicable)

acceptance_criteria.given: the user right-clicks on a cell with a checkbox-style edit style
acceptance_criteria.when: the context menu is displayed
acceptance_criteria.then: the Detail item displays the raw value (e.g., 'Y') followed by a tab character and the lookup label (e.g., 'Yes')

user_stories.technical_notes: Legacy uo_anc_dw events: rbuttondown (EVENT-002) captures cell value/format/lookup-display into is_popdetail; pfc_prermbmenu (EVENT-003) injects it into menu_dw's m_detail.m_naiyou; rbuttonup (EVENT-001) builds and shows the popup.

user_stories.title: Automatic Text Commit on Field Exit
user_stories.i_want_to: have my pending text edits automatically committed when I move focus away from a grid cell
user_stories.so_that: I do not lose my changes while navigating between fields

acceptance_criteria.given: the user has edited the text in a cell and the cell still has focus
acceptance_criteria.when: the user tabs or clicks away to another field
acceptance_criteria.then: the pending text edit is accepted and committed to the data buffer

acceptance_criteria.given: the user is still editing the cell (focus has not yet been lost) and attempts to perform another action that triggers an accept
acceptance_criteria.when: the system tries to accept the text while the cell still holds focus
acceptance_criteria.then: the accept is deferred until focus is lost, preventing premature validation

acceptance_criteria.given: the user rapidly switches focus between multiple cells
acceptance_criteria.when: the losefocus event fires asynchronously
acceptance_criteria.then: each cell's text is eventually accepted without data loss or race conditions

user_stories.technical_notes: Legacy uo_anc_dw event losefocus (EVENT-010) sets ib_focus=False and posts u_accepttext (EVENT-008), which calls AcceptText() only if ib_focus is False. This deferred pattern avoids re-entrancy.
user_stories.migration_hint: Use React onBlur handler to flush pending text state into grid data; guard with a ref to prevent duplicate commits.

acceptance_criteria.then: the system rejects the change, displays a visual indicator (e.g., border highlight), and the field remains in edit mode

acceptance_criteria.when: the focus moves to another cell
acceptance_criteria.then: the value is accepted without any validation error

acceptance_criteria.then: the system allows the clear action but immediately triggers the required-field error, prompting the user to enter a value

user_stories.title: Notify Descendant on Cell Value Change
user_stories.i_want_to: have the system immediately relay the details of any cell value change I make to the screen’s underlying logic
user_stories.so_that: additional validations, calculations, or workflow rules can be applied automatically without extra action on my part

acceptance_criteria.given: the user edits a value in a cell and moves focus away (e.g., tab key, mouse click to another cell)
acceptance_criteria.when: the user navigates away from the edited cell
acceptance_criteria.then: the system passes the column name, row number, and new value to the descendant hook (u_post_itemchange), and the change is accepted

acceptance_criteria.given: a descendant has overridden the post-item-change hook to return a reject code (il_rtn = -1) based on some business rule
acceptance_criteria.when: the user tries to leave the edited cell that triggers the reject rule
acceptance_criteria.then: the system rejects the change, keeping the previous value, and the cell remains in edit mode

acceptance_criteria.given: the user rapidly changes multiple cells in quick succession
acceptance_criteria.when: the user rapidly modifies multiple cells
acceptance_criteria.then: each change triggers the descendant hook independently without interference or race conditions

user_stories.technical_notes: Legacy uo_anc_dw event itemchanged (EVENT-011) sets il_rtn=0, calls This.Event u_post_itemchange(dwo.name, row, data), and returns il_rtn. Descendant can override u_post_itemchange to set il_rtn and control accept/reject behavior.
user_stories.migration_hint: Implement an onCellChange callback prop in the React base grid component; pass (columnName, rowIndex, newValue) to the consumer. The consumer can return a boolean to accept/reject.

user_stories.i_want_to: see a clear notification when a database operation fails while I am working with the data grid

acceptance_criteria.when: the user clicks the Save button
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays an error dialog with the specific database error message (e.g., error code and text)

acceptance_criteria.given: a database error occurs but the centralized error handler f_dberror() is not available or throws an exception
acceptance_criteria.when: the user saves data and the error handler fails

acceptance_criteria.then: the system does not show any additional error dialog beyond what the custom handler displays

review_guidance.guideline: Framework/menu/ancestor unit; business-value gates were waived (relaxed gates). Light spot-check only — safe to accept.
review_guidance.failure_summary:
Gate 1 (Schema): PASS. All root fields present, IDs validated, category/functions/business_context correct. Success_criteria empty but that's a WARN, not a fail.
Gate 2 (Personas): PASS. All stories use "Business Operations Clerk", a domain-appropriate label.
Gate 3 (Story ID Format): PASS. Feature ID ANCES-001-F1 correctly uses module abbreviation derived from MOD-ANCES. Story IDs follow MFU-discriminated pattern, no Epic IDs.
Gate 4 (So_That Precision): PASS. Every so_that clause expresses a specific business outcome.
Gate 5 (AC Rigour): FAIL. S6-AC2 'when' clause describes a system action ("the system tries to accept the text while the cell still holds focus") rather than a user-initiated operation. S6-AC3 uses a PowerBuilder event name ("when the losefocus event fires asynchronously") and is not a user action. Both violate the Gherkin When Clause Rule: the 'when' must describe a user-initiated business operation. ACs S6-AC2 and S6-AC3 must be rewritten.
Gate 6 (Story Count/Sizing/Validity): PASS. Story count (10) ≤ function ceiling (13). All story_points valid. Four-condition test passed for all stories.
Gate 7 (Bounding Box): FAIL. Feature is non-infrastructure, S.3 contains control "uo_anc_dw", but bounding_box.controls[] is empty. Gate 7d requires population with the verbatim physical name. Add "uo_anc_dw" to controls[].
Gate 8 (Technical Notes/Migration): PASS. Every story names legacy events/functions and gives specific migration hints.
Gate 9 (Evidence Consistency): PASS. Happy Path ACs align with referenced SRS events; negative/edge ACs use GAP:: markers and are exempt.

results.module_business_description: Governs the flexible free-form inquiry of fixed asset master data, enabling interactive sorting, filtering, editing, and multi-format export (Excel, Print) through a reusable grid control interface.

features.title: List View Data Grid Operations with Sorting, Clipboard, and Inline Editing
features.description: Enables users to interact with a list view DataWindow grid including column header sorting, row focus selection with single/multi-select, right-click clipboard operations (copy, cut, paste, select all, detail display), F12 print screen, and inline cell editing with buffer-level validation.

functions.label: Sort data grid by column header (Header Click Sort)
functions.description: When the user clicks a column header, the data grid is sorted in ascending order for that column. This helps users quickly organize records without leaving the view.

functions.label: Reset grid sort order (Sort Reset)
functions.description: The user can clear the active sorting, returning the grid to its original unsorted state. This resets any column header highlighting, providing a clean view.

functions.label: Print current screen via F12 key (F12 Print Screen)
functions.description: Pressing the F12 key initiates a screen capture that can be printed or saved. This allows users to quickly capture and output the visible data.

functions.label: Copy selected text to clipboard (Right-Click Copy)
functions.description: The user can select text in a cell and copy it to the clipboard via right-click. This enables quick data reuse in other applications.

functions.label: Cut selected text to clipboard (Right-Click Cut)
functions.description: The user can cut selected text from a cell and place it on the clipboard. This allows moving data out of the grid for pasting elsewhere.

functions.label: Paste clipboard content into grid (Right-Click Paste)
functions.description: The user can paste text from the clipboard into the focused grid cell. This facilitates entering data from external sources.

functions.label: Select all text in the grid (Right-Click Select All)
functions.description: The user can select all text within the current grid cell for copying or cutting. This streamlines bulk data operations.

functions.label: Preview cell value in popup menu (Right-Click Detail Display)
functions.description: Right-clicking a cell displays its full value formatted according to its data type (e.g., dates, numbers). This gives the user a quick way to view complete cell contents without editing.

functions.label: Validate and accept edited cell data (Cell Item Changed)
functions.description: When a user modifies a cell, the change is submitted for validation and processing. The system either accepts the new value, rejects it, or advances based on business rules, ensuring data integrity.

functions.label: Select and highlight rows via click (Row Focus Changed)
functions.description: The user can click on rows to highlight them, with support for single or multiple selection using Shift and Ctrl keys. This provides visual feedback and selection controls for batch operations.

business_context.current_state: A PowerBuilder custom visual user object (uo_anc_dw_list) that provides a DataWindow grid with header-click sorting, right-click clipboard operations (Copy/Cut/Paste/Select All/Detail Display), row focus selection, F12 print screen, and in-cell data editing with buffer-level validation.
business_context.target_state: A React data grid component (<DataGrid />) integrating column sorting, clipboard operations, inline editing, and print functionality, backed by REST APIs for data persistence.

results.module_business_description: Governs the flexible free-form inquiry of fixed asset master data, enabling interactive sorting, filtering, editing, and multi-format export (Excel, Print) through a reusable grid control interface.

features.title: Transactional Data Maintenance: Search, CRUD, Export and Print
features.description: Enables users to perform full data maintenance on a transactional dataset: search for records using pre-checks, insert, copy, and delete rows, update data with validation, clear the working grid, export results to Excel, print outputs, and close the window, all within a client-server PowerBuilder environment with transaction control.
features.source: SRS UIBlueprint for w_fa_ances_infree, encompassing all 13 S.5 events (search, row insert/copy/delete, update, clear, Excel export, print, close, and window initialization/close)

functions.label: Search for transaction records (Search)
functions.description: The user triggers a search after a pre-check validation. The system resets any prior sorting, retrieves the matching data from the server, and updates the interface buttons accordingly, ensuring accurate and ready-to-manipulate results.

functions.label: Insert a new blank row into the grid (Row Insert)
functions.description: The user adds an empty row to the transaction grid for data entry. Upon insertion, the system enables copy and delete actions for subsequent row manipulation, streamlining the data capture process.

functions.label: Copy the selected row (Row Copy)
functions.description: This function is intended to duplicate the currently selected row for faster data entry. In this ancestor window, the logic is not yet implemented, leaving the actual copy behavior to be defined in a descendant.

functions.label: Delete the selected row from the grid (Row Delete)
functions.description: The user removes the currently selected transaction row. If the grid becomes empty after deletion, the system disables the copy and delete buttons to prevent invalid operations, maintaining data integrity.

functions.label: Validate and save changes to the database (Update)
functions.description: The user initiates a save of all modifications after the system performs full validation. A confirmation dialog is displayed; upon acceptance, the changes are committed to the database via the FATRA transaction object, with an error message shown if the commit fails.

functions.label: Export search results to Excel or CSV (Excel Export)
functions.description: After a successful search, the user can export the displayed data to an external file. The system converts the data buffer into an Excel or CSV file, enabling offline analysis and reporting.

functions.label: Print the transaction data (Print)
functions.description: The user requests a printout of the current transaction grid. After confirming the print dialog, the system prepares a print buffer and sends it to the printer; if the user cancels, the operation is aborted.

functions.label: Capture and print the current screen (F12 Print Screen)
functions.description: The user presses the F12 key to take a snapshot of the current window. The system uses a global function to capture the screen image and send it directly to the printer, with formatting variants available via key flag options.

functions.label: Initialize the transaction maintenance window (Window Open Initialization)
functions.description: When the window opens, the system automatically positions it at the center, connects the datawindow controls, binds the database transaction object, and sets the initial enabled/disabled state of buttons. This ensures the user starts with a properly configured workspace.

functions.label: Clear the grid and reset the search form (Clear)
functions.description: The user clears all entries and search results from the grid. The system re-binds the database transaction and sends a signal to the parent window to reset the search header, readying the interface for a new search.

functions.label: Close the parent window (Close)
functions.description: The user closes the entire transaction maintenance window and returns to the previous application area. This action terminates the current session.

functions.label: Activate the focused button with Enter (Enter Key Shortcut)
functions.description: The user presses the Enter key to trigger the action of the currently focused command button, providing a keyboard alternative to mouse clicks for faster navigation and operation.

functions.label: Roll back pending changes on window close (Window Close)
functions.description: When the user closes the maintenance window, the system automatically rolls back any uncommitted database changes associated with the FATRA transaction, ensuring data consistency.

business_context.current_state: A PowerBuilder MDI child window (w_fa_ances_infree) where users search, insert, copy, and delete transaction rows, update validated data, clear the grid, export to Excel, print, and close the window. Operations are bound to the FATRA transaction object with full client-server interaction.
business_context.target_state: A React transactional data maintenance page (<TransactionMaintenancePanel />) with REST endpoints for searching (GET /api/v1/transactions), inserting (POST /api/v1/transactions), updating (PUT /api/v1/transactions/{id}), deleting (DELETE /api/v1/transactions/{id}), exporting (GET /api/v1/transactions/export), and print (GET /api/v1/transactions/print). All mutations occur within transactional boundaries with server-side validation and parameterised queries.

success_criteria: All database queries must use parameterised statements to prevent SQL injection.
All data modification operations (insert, update, delete) must execute within an atomic transaction with rollback on failure.
All transactional changes must be logged in an audit trail with user identity, timestamp, and before/after values.
srs_section_scope: S.3 all controls: search, insert, copy, delete, update, clear, excel, print, close buttons; dw_1 DataWindow
S.4 validation rules: VAL-001 (search pre-check), VAL-002 (update validation), VAL-003 (print confirmation)
S.5 Event #1: Search (retrieve data with pre-check)
S.5 Event #6: Clear grid and reset

acceptance_criteria.then: the system detects the conflict and displays an error message 'Data has been changed by another user. Please reload.'

acceptance_criteria.given: the export component encounters a failure such as a file system error
acceptance_criteria.when: the user clicks the Excel Export button
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays an error message 'Export failed' and does not produce a file

acceptance_criteria.given: no search results have been loaded
